name: TrovePrisons
description:
⛏️ Trove Prisons

A Bedrock prison server where every block counts.

Mine. Sell. Rank up. Prestige.

Work your way through Mines A to Z, each with its own theme, ambience and reset show. Rank up all the way to Z, then prestige with no cap for permanent perks from the Prestige Shop, prestige-only mines, trails, pickaxes and armour.

Your pickaxe grows with you

Every block levels up your pickaxe. Unlock Haste, XP Bonus, Auto-smelt and Explosive, add runes like Merchant at the Enchanter, and chase lucky blocks, treasure chests, Gold Rush and Blood Moon.

Fight for it

Our switch-hit PvP rewards real skill: switch your hotbar mid-combo for an extra hit. Take it to the Colosseum arena, ranked duels with an Elo ladder, wager duels, bounties, King of the Hill, The Pit and arena tournaments. Practice against sim bots with the switch-hit drill.

Build your crew

Start a gang with a bank, vault, perk shop, gang mines and declared gang wars. Claim a sky plot, decorate it with exclusive Trove blocks, and upgrade it as you grow.

Trade and gamble

An auction house, player trading, a market with price alerts, a full casino island with dealers, coinflip, scratch cards and an hourly lottery jackpot.

Always something to do

Daily streaks, quests, achievements, playtime rewards, crates with a spin reel, world bosses, server events, chat games, parkour, pets, cosmetics, and weekly top-10 rewards.

🎮 Bedrock Edition: play on mobile, console or PC

💬 Join our Discord: https://dsc.gg/trove-prisons

🏆 Weekly and seasonal leaderboards with real prizes
